title: Ankhorage App Store Connect Deployment Provider
summary: Provides an App Store Connect deployment provider for Ankhorage application shipment.
purpose: Isolate App Store Connect deployment behavior behind a provider boundary.
responsibilities: Provide the App Store Connect deployment provider composition.
Adapt App Store Connect-specific deployment behavior to the deployment-provider boundary.
boundaries: Does not own deployment orchestration or cross-provider release policy.
Does not implement other deployment providers.
audience: Applications and deployment tooling that select a deployment provider.
useCases: Compose App Store Connect-backed application deployment.

architecture.role: An outbound deployment-provider adapter with an explicit composition entrypoint.
invariants: App Store Connect-specific behavior remains behind the provider boundary.

limitations: Only App Store Connect-backed deployment is provided.
